feature: Native Mac essential translation caption legibility

scenarios.name: Actual Mac translation availability guidance remains legible on native surfaces
scenarios.given: the production Mac translation status explains that speech is needed on the Summary card or Languages rail with standard system contrast
scenarios.when: the native view appears in supported Aqua or Dark Aqua appearance
scenarios.then: the actual standard-contrast appearance reaches SwiftUI, the caption fits its native host, the opaque background matches the resolved production surface, and the actual caption meets the 4.5:1 small-text benchmark with native render evidence retained
